automated.summary: Verify is green at the final capture-gate commit: dual-runtime parity, scaffold integrity, and 278 automated tests. The gate's structure detection was rebuilt after the branch review found it counted headings inside examples; every concrete bypass the reviews named is now closed and covered by a regression case.
commands_run: FACTORY_STRUCTURAL_CMD='python3 factory/scripts/check_dual_runtime.py' FACTORY_TYPECHECK_CMD='python3 factory/scripts/check_factory_scaffold.py' FACTORY_TEST_CMD='uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests -q' python3 factory/scripts/verify.py
uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k 'parse_sections or spec_ or signoff or doctor_reports or scaffolded_brief'
tests_added_or_updated: test_parse_sections_maps_headings_to_bodies - the shared parser answers 'which sections does this document have', including CRLF documents

test_parse_sections_reads_examples_as_examples - fenced blocks, exact-length closers, backtick info strings, HTML comments, tilde fences, unterminated constructs, list-nested fences, NBSP closers, verbatim raw blocks and container blocks; each case broke one earlier attempt
test_spec_confirm_refuses_headings_that_only_exist_in_an_example - the story's 'complete or refused' criterion asserted end to end
test_scaffolded_brief_carries_the_canonical_headings - template, live brief, and the conventions doc tied to one ordered heading tuple so they cannot drift apart
test_signoff_refuses_a_brief_missing_a_required_heading - sign-off names every absent heading rather than failing on the first
test_signoff_refuses_a_heading_with_an_empty_body - a heading with no content is an absent section
test_spec_confirm_refuses_a_spec_missing_required_headings - Why / Behaviour / Acceptance criteria are required at confirmation
test_spec_check_never_refuses_a_complete_spec - the wrong-refusal direction is asserted, not assumed
test_spec_save_still_accepts_an_incomplete_draft - capture stays cheap; only confirmation is gated
test_doctor_reports_legacy_capture_without_blocking - advisory only, and an absent BRIEF.md is now reported as the most incomplete a brief can be
automated.pass_fail_summary: 278 passed in 453.08s; check_dual_runtime and check_factory_scaffold both exit 0.
remaining_gaps: Structure detection approximates a CommonMark block parser rather than being one: setext headings, link reference definitions and block quotes are not interpreted. factory/scripts is stdlib-only by design, so adopting a parser is decision 0020's question rather than a patch.
An unterminated fence, comment or raw block masks nothing, deviating from CommonMark deliberately toward the wrong-refusal asymmetry. Recorded in decision 0020.

The deterministic runner falls back to a Node toolchain when the FACTORY_*_CMD variables are unset, so an invocation that omits them reports red against a stack this repo does not have. Out of PH-1 scope; ledgered as a lesson.
